shortBulletSummary: Hotter-than-expected US CPI data sparked a broad crypto market sell-off, intensifying rate hike concerns.
Nearly $950 million in crypto long positions were liquidated following the latest inflation data.
Bitcoin tested $80,000, and Ethereum fell below $2,400 amid macro pressures.
The Crypto Fear & Greed Index shows a "Neutral" sentiment, but underlying fear persists.
Rising geopolitical tensions are pushing oil prices higher, adding to market uncertainty.
